payload.goal: Port the parity-critical core of the engine — fold (packages/engine/src/core/fold.ts, ~1.5k lines), the event schema and envelope, the cursor — to Rust as one library exposed three ways: UniFFI bindings for the native Swift Mac app (sofar-cloud desktop-v2), wasm for the webapp and the Bun API, and the existing TS CLI wrapping it. The CLI, init, doctor, MCP and driver stay TypeScript around the core. Gate before any surface switches: the Rust fold deep-equals the TS fold on every real events.jsonl in this repo and in sofar-cloud (fold parity, the rule sofar-cloud D7 already enforces). Hook latency is not the motive (sofar status runs in ~50ms under node); one core across Swift, web and server is.

tasks.title: Corpus: every real events.jsonl from this repo and sofar-cloud, folded by the TS engine into golden snapshots
Rust crate scaffold (sofar-core) with a fold entry that must deep-equal the goldens; CI gate
Event schema and envelope validation (schema/events.ts, tool-inputs.ts)
Fold (core/fold.ts) including guards, freshness and the adjacency graph
UniFFI → Swift package consumed by sofar-cloud desktop-v2 task 4.1
wasm build consumed by the webapp and the Bun API (replaces the browser-aliased TS fold)
TS CLI wraps the core; foldLines keeps its signature
Each surface switches only after parity is green on the full corpus; TS fold retired last

payload.because: Founder (Sep 14): the app is greenfield and iPhone is imminent, so there is no reason to build on a bridge first. The bridge stays as a fallback behind desktop-v2 RecordSource protocol if parity is not green in time; the parity harness (Phase 1) is the gate either way. desktop-v2 D2 records the same call from the app side and rejects GPUI.
payload.chose: engine-core starts now, in parallel with sofar-cloud desktop-v2 phase 1 (sign-in), so the Swift app folds through UniFFI from its first record window
payload.over: Running the port behind the apps, with the Swift app on a sofar-CLI bridge until the core lands

payload.note: User ruling 2026-09-21: fold into rust-core. rust-core Phase 2 already built the core port engine-core planned: schema codegen, envelope, fold with conformance parity, digest render. The bindings (UniFFI Swift, wasm, TS wrap), D1 and the all-real-logs parity gate carry over as rust-core note B1-B3, which the rust-core branch turns into plan tasks.
